item.title: Amazon Kuiper gets key regulatory approval to operate in Nigeria
item.description: Amazon’s Project Kuiper has secured NCC permission to operate in Nigeria, starting in 2026, intensifying competition with Starlink.

item.title: Uganda orders internet shutdown ahead of elections
item.description: Uganda has ordered mobile networks and ISPs to suspend public internet access, block new SIM card registrations, and stop roaming calls.

item.title: 👨🏿‍🚀TechCabal Daily – Is AGOA making a comeback? | TechCabal
item.description: On Tuesday, US Reps voted for AGOA renewal, months after the tariff relief programme for Africa expired. Next, the Senate will decide.

item.title: Paystack Inc. acquires Nigerian microfinance bank
item.description: Paystack Inc. has entered Nigeria’s banking sector with the acquisition of Ladder Microfinance Bank, giving the fintech greater control over the funds it processes after a decade focused on payments.

item.title: Airtel Money plans overdraft service to battle Safaricom’s Fuliza
item.description: Airtel Kenya plans to launch a digital overdraft service on Airtel Money, setting up its first direct challenge to Safaricom’s Fuliza.

item.title: After 2025 miss, Lebara Nigeria prioritises agent network expansion
item.description: The ARP marks Lebara Nigeria’s latest pre-launch move as the company seeks to build brand presence and distribution capacity.

item.title: Malik Afegbua: The man building digital ancestors
item.description: Malik Afegbua explains why he’s building a library of ancestors using custom AI datasets to fight cultural bias and reclaim the African tech narrative.

item.title: Stronger capital, bigger loans: Africa’s banking outlook for 2026
item.description: African banks rebuilt their balance sheets in 2025. In 2026, they must turn capital strength into real lending, growth, and stability.

item.title: What investors expect in Francophone Africa in 2026
item.description: We asked three investors what they think of Francophone Africa and how they predict the tech ecosystem to grow in 2026.

item.title: US suspends visa processing for Nigeria, Egypt, Ghana and 73 others
item.description: The US is suspending all visa processing for applicants from 75 countries, including Nigeria, Egypt, Algeria, and Somalia.
